notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Release
notes.content:
STEAM NEXT FEST DEMO

The Steam Next Fest starts on June 9th but you can already play the new demo for SEMP 64!


New Level - About twice as large as the previous one

Carry Players - Press 'F' or the left stick to get carried by another player

New Level Mechanics - Spikeballs, blades and more

New Music - Listen to the first two original tracks for SEMP 64 by SpielmitStil

Speedrun Mode - Start a speedrun that automatically tracks your times

Bug fixes - Oh so many bug fixes

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Update
notes.content:
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1149627284689530979/1375406827239510078/old-new.png?ex=683192ed&is=6830416d&hm=51a85a4399c87a5d51d351f3df0535be137d5b2a43124fee0bce0784f65f43eb&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1872&height=527

Steam Next Fest Update

A new map will be playable when the Steam Next Fest starts on June 9th!
It's much larger, has new level elements, new challenges and has a lot more to offer.

Make sure to check out the update once it drops, even if you've already completed the current level.


The update also features some new player mechanics and of course a loot of bug fixes.
It may even adds a few new cosmetics, who knows.


Hope to see you there on June 9th!
